chunks.subject: AP World History
chunks.title: SAQ 4 — No Stimulus (3 points) — Set 1: revolutions
chunks.content: AP World History SAQ 4 (No Stimulus), 3 points, one per part. Set 1 prompts: A [1] identify one factor that contributed to the outbreak of revolutions in the period; B [1] explain one way revolutionary movements used ideologies in their attempts to gain support/power; C [1] explain one way revolutionary movements were challenged as they attempted to enact change. 'Identify' = correct answer; 'Explain' = how/why. Common failure: vague identification; explain parts that describe rather than give a causal mechanism.

chunks.subject: AP World History
chunks.title: SAQ 4 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 4A, 3/3
chunks.content: SAQ 4 (Set 1) scored 3/3 (A 1, B 1, C 1). Identified a factor behind revolutions and explained both an ideological use and a challenge revolutionary movements faced. Full-credit model.

chunks.subject: AP World History
chunks.title: SAQ 4 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 4B, 2/3
chunks.content: SAQ 4 (Set 1) scored 2/3 (A 1, B 0, C 1). Identified a factor (A) and explained a challenge (C) but did not earn the ideology-use explanation (B). Illustrates missing one Explain part.

chunks.subject: AP World History
chunks.title: SAQ 4 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 4C, 1/3
chunks.content: SAQ 4 (Set 1) scored 1/3 (A 1, B 0, C 0). Identified a factor only. Lost both Explain parts (no ideology use, no challenge). Illustrates a response that names a cause but cannot explain movements' ideologies or obstacles.
